title: Users
intro: Every user is a Linux account of its own, so files they create belong to them. Their uids are never given out again.

field.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.

create.title: Create user
create.intro: The user gets a home folder on the first pool when there is one.

password.title: New password for {name}
password.intro: The user is signed out everywhere and signs in with the new password.
password.fileServices: SMB and SFTP use the new password as well.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.intro: The account goes. The user's files and home folder stay, and the user id is never given to anyone else.

fileServices.title: File services
fileServices.admin: Administrators may use every file service.
fileServices.signInOnce: Not ready for SMB and SFTP yet: the user signs in once on the web, or you set a new password.
